reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 171-180 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 25 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs were NOT opened. The FRDB snapshot /tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a, verified) was read with every column containing 'cmax' dropped before any row was printed. Arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex, population and application comments only. Original-source Cmax values were then read from original tables/text. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Full originals read: PMDA Suglat review report (A100) and CTD modules 2.7.2 (K100) and 2.7.6 (K101) PDFs (ipragliflozin); PMC6349788 full text (radiprodil); PMC2014989 full-text HTML (asimadoline); PMC1400680 scanned PDF (loprazolam; fetched with a fresh, cookie-less local Chrome profile because of a Cloudflare interstitial; transient copy in session scratchpad). Closed/blocked originals time-boxed to abstracts/landing pages: Springer (pyronaridine, bunazosin), Wiley (epristeride), Elsevier/ScienceDirect (bucillamine, tiropramide), Clinical Therapeutics (HM30181). Only PubMed E-utilities (MCP), PMC, Europe PMC, PMDA and publisher landing pages were queried. No email, contact identifier or Unpaywall was used; no repository file was modified.
unresolved_issues: Pyronaridine (9822): ineligible - abstract states parent PK measured in whole blood (not plasma); dose is 720 mg tetraphosphate salt (~410 mg free base). Full text paywalled.

Ipragliflozin L-proline (10404): 9 arms verified from PMDA review/CTD tables; frdb_10316 ineligible (dosed 5 min before breakfast). Doses of 本剤/本薬 are free-ipragliflozin basis (50 mg = 64.3 mg L-proline cocrystal), consistent with the free-ipragliflozin manifest SMILES - no salt correction needed. frdb_10342 source PK N=5 vs FRDB n=6.
Epristeride (613): unverified - Wiley full text blocked; abstract has no Cmax/fasting/formulation.
Loprazolam (811): both arms verified_with_caveat (dosage form and mesilate/base salt basis not stated; frdb_1764 is healthy elderly 67-83 y).
Bunazosin (2070): both arms ineligible - source is the sustained-release Bunazosin Retard 6 mg formulation.
Asimadoline (6752): 3 arms verified_with_caveat (dosage form/salt basis not stated; water load and post-tmax saline infusion). Values are Results-text means, no table.

Bucillamine (408), tiropramide (2916), HM-30181 (31699): all arms unverified - Elsevier full texts blocked; tiropramide test/reference arm identity and HCl salt basis unknown; HM30181 salt basis/fasting unconfirmed.

arms.reason: Mass-balance study (6 healthy males, 720 mg pyronaridine tetraphosphate + 14C tracer). The abstract states the dosed-parent PK was measured in WHOLE BLOOD ('parent concentrations in blood were determined with LC/MS'; total radioactivity by AMS in blood), not plasma, so the arm fails the plasma-matrix criterion. The dose is expressed as the tetraphosphate salt (720 mg salt ≈ 410 mg free base by MW 518.1 vs ~910 salt), which would also need dose-basis correction. FRDB t1/2 5.03 days matches the abstract parent t1/2. Fasting and formulation not verifiable (Springer full text paywalled).

coordinator_review.scope: Manifest and source-audit consistency cross-check only; frozen prediction file not opened.
notes: Ipragliflozin has nine source-mapped, explicitly fasted parent-plasma arms plus one pre-breakfast ineligible arm. The original doses are free-ipragliflozin basis, matching the manifest structure; no post-hoc salt conversion is made.
The 300 mg ipragliflozin arm has original PK n=5 against FRDB n=6; the source value and discrepancy are retained for review.
Loprazolam and asimadoline remain caveated because the original dosage form/salt basis is unstated. Radiprodil oral suspension remains caveated pending uniform IR-liquid adjudication.
